objective: Make the shared AGENTS.md, Skills, and Plugins workspace stable, informative, update-aware, deletable, and automatically synchronized.

acceptanceCriteria.description: AGENTS.md, Skills, and Plugins tabs remain on one row and switching panels does not shift the workspace geometry.
The AGENTS.md panel displays the file last-modified time from disk.
Every Skill row displays declared version when available, last-modified time, check-for-update behavior for managed sources, and deletion for shared Skills.
Every shared Plugin row displays version, last-modified time, check-for-update behavior for managed sources, and deletion.

At application startup and disk refresh, missing default-home Skills are imported non-destructively and shared Plugins are collected and synchronized to every managed Profile without requiring manual import/sync buttons.
Rust regression tests, frontend build, formatting check, Rust check, and rendered desktop UI verification pass.

constraints: Preserve unrelated uncommitted work and the existing visual language.
Skill import must never overwrite an existing same-name shared Skill.
Plugin synchronization may mutate only shared plugin storage and tool-owned managed Profile homes.
nonGoals: Manage OpenAI bundled or official Marketplace plugins.
Add a dependency or redesign the application shell.

reasons: Automatic startup synchronization writes shared resource state and managed Profile plugin caches/configuration.

escalateWhen: Automatic synchronization requires touching unmanaged Profile homes, official plugins, or overwriting same-name Skills.
requiredApprovals: Automatically import missing default-home Skills and synchronize third-party shared Plugins at startup and disk refresh.
